festivals.what: Noche de Muertos, Janitzio island (Lake Pátzcuaro): held on the night of 1 to 2 November. In 2026 the island's cemetery was closed to the public because of rehabilitation works by Fonatur; island families still held their vigil and visitors watched from a raised viewing platform. The state tourism office expects normal access to the cemetery again in 2027, once the works finish. Rules and access for 2027 are not yet published.

culture-cycles.note: 2027 programme not yet published. The vigil is held by island families; visitors follow the community's and the state's instructions on the night.
